title: System Support Administrator
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and skilled IT Support Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing technical support and ensuring the smooth operation of our IT systems. This includes troubleshooting hardware and software issues, configuring and maintaining network devices, and supporting end\-users with their technical needs

Key Responsibilities:

Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network issues.

Install, configure, and maintain operating systems, software applications, and hardware.

Perform regular system updates and backups.

Monitor system performance and ensure optimal functioning.

Configure and maintain network devices such as routers, switches, and firewalls.

Ensure network security through proper configuration of VPNs, firewalls, and antivirus software.

Troubleshoot network connectivity issues.

Assist users with setting up new accounts and systems.

Document and maintain accurate records of user issues and resolutions.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* total work: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Planning Engineer
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day!**


To ensure business continuity within the Demand Management unit of Siemens Energy's Compression Global Operations in Naroda, India, this Planning Engineer role is critical for aligning manufacturing capacity with customer demand. The position supports the execution of complex compression system projects by managing production schedules and material requirements. To address these business aims, this role focuses on production scheduling, material demand planning, and cross\-functional coordination. These core areas ensure optimal utilization of manufacturing resources and timely delivery of compression packages. Given the focus on demand management and production planning, the ideal candidate will have strong experience in ERP systems (SAP), material requirements planning (MRP), and manufacturing workflows. A background in mechanical engineering or production planning within a heavy engineering or rotating equipment industry is essential.

**How You’ll Make an Impact.**

* Develop, maintain, and optimize master production schedules (MPS) for compression systems and components.
* Analyze manufacturing capacity constraints and coordinate with workshop managers to resolve bottlenecks.
* Monitor progress of production orders against the baseline schedule and implement corrective actions for delays.
* Execute Material Requirements Planning (MRP) runs to ensure timely availability of parts and raw materials.
* Collaborate with procurement and logistics to track critical components and prevent material shortages.
* Optimize inventory levels to balance manufacturing requirements with working capital targets.
* Coordinate with Project Management, Engineering, and Quality departments to align project milestones with manufacturing schedules.
* Prepare and present regular production progress reports, KPIs, and capacity utilization forecasts to management.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives (Lean/Kaizen) to streamline planning processes and reduce lead times**.**

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Production, or Industrial Engineering
* 5 to 8 years of experience in production planning, scheduling, or demand management within heavy manufacturing, rotating equipment, or oil \& gas sectors.
* The ideal candidate will have strong experience in ERP systems (SAP), material requirements planning (MRP), and manufacturing workflows.
* Master Production Scheduling (MPS). Capacity Planning \& Leveling.
* Material Requirements Planning (MRP).
* SAP PP/MM Modules.
* Data Analysis \& Reporting (Excel, PowerBI). Understanding of Manufacturing Workflows (Rotating Equipment/Compression Systems).
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration. Problem\-Solving \& Bottleneck Analysis

**About the Team**


Our **Transformation of Industry** division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities. Candidates want to learn about the divisions they will be joining–the structure, how it works together, and the role it plays in driving Siemens Energy’s mission forward.

**Who is Siemens Energy?**


At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies crafted in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.


Our distributed team is committed to making balanced, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.


Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo

**Our Commitment to Diversity**


Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

**Rewards/Benefits**

* All employees are automatically covered under the Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for Meal Card to all its employees which will be as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy as a part of CTC, tax saving measure
* Flexi Pay empowers employees with the choice to customize the amount in some of the salary components within a defined range thereby optimizing the tax benefits. Accordingly, each employee is empowered to decide on the best Possible net income out of the same fixed individual base pay on a monthly basis

title: Sr. Project Engineer - ELV
description:
Dear Candidates ,

**Please find below description for your reference :**

**About company :\-** *Microlink Solutions Pvt. Ltd*. was founded in 1996 at the inception of Enterprise Networks with a simple vision – to do excellent \& innovative things. MICROLINK's business is focused solely on the front end of the Technology: Networking, System Infrastructure, Datacenter and Security solutions.

For more details Visit :\- www.microlink.co.in

**Any Interested candidates can share their CV on devarshim@microlink.co.in or Whatsapp 9016706079 .** 

**Designation : Sr. Project Engineer \- ELV**

Responsible for the effective execution of all the Projects undertaken by Microlink. The job includes day to day management of a team of Project leaders \& Team leaders, Project Scheduling, PM Process management, Stakeholder management, Quality – time \& Cost control, Escalation management, Project Communication management. This roles also includes assisting in designing the solution , identifying the BOM \& Quote submission for certain key accounts to HOD.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITY**

**Project Management**

· Day to Day monitoring \& Control of Project Leaders \& Team Leaders

· Establish project plans including timelines, resource requirement, resource planning and resource optimization.

· Planning and designing the project and proactively monitoring its progress, resolving issues and initiating appropriate corrective action

* Ensuring the delivery of services from projects is to the appropriate level of quality, on time and within budget, in accordance with the program plan.

· Develop and control deadlines, budgets and activities

· Monitor progress; address any issues across the project interfaces, ensuring that project deliverables and milestones are achieved.

* Achieves operational objectives by contributing information and recommendations to strategic plans and reviews and preparing and completing action plans
* Implements production, productivity, quality, and customer\-service standards by resolving problems, completing audits, identifying trends, determining system improvements, and implementing change.
* Ensuring timely completion of projects with defined Quality standards \& within given cost budget
* Ensuring excellent feedback from customer post completion of projects. Expected Target is more than 95% \& greater.
* Ensuring effective conclusion of Project internally within ML system – BPI software \& smooth handover to Service team
* Assisting HOD in terms of working on the design / BOM / proposal making , submission \& follow up till Order closure for certain key accounts as per guidance provided by HOD

**Customer Management**

· Build long term relationship with Customers

· Work quickly to address customer issues

· Schedule regular meetings with customer to ensure they are satisfied

**Collaboration and cross\-functional co\-ordination**

* Coordinate with cross\-functional team to ensure that all parties are on track with project requirement, deadlines and schedule.
* Facilitating change request to ensure that all parties are informed of the impact on schedule and budget.
* Managing communications with all stakeholders

· Establish and maintain relationship with third parties/ vendors.

**Leadership and Team management**

· Responsible for nurturing existing Project team

· Communicates job expectations by planning, monitoring, appraising, and reviewing job contributions

· Lead and evaluate project managers and other staff

**MIS and Reports**

· Reporting the progress of the project at regular intervals to the concern stakeholders.

· Provide regular project reports to the management.

* Conduct post project evaluation and identifying successful and unsuccessful project elements.

**TECHNICAL/FUNCTIONAL SKILLS REQUIRED**

· Good experience of Project execution Management

· Full knowledge of entire project life cycle management

· Good skills for people management, Team building \& Team management

· Excellent skills in customer management \& stakeholder management

· **Should have thorough knowledge of various ELV System and Technology i.e. CCTV, ACS, TAS, PAS, Passive/Cabling Infrastructure, Video Monitoring System, Visitor management system.**

· **Should have knowledge of different ELV product line understanding i.e. Honeywell, Matrix, Hikvision, Sony, Vivotek, GST, EST, Bosch, etc.**

· **Should be able to implement CCTV, ACS, TAS, PAS, VMS, BMS solutions.** 

· **Experience deploying and/or maintaining an enterprise Surveillance system, Fire detection system and physical security system.** 

**SOFT SKILLS REQUIRED:**

· Excellent Leadership and influencing skills

· Effective mentoring, counseling and motivating skills

· Problem solving and negotiation skills

· Conflict resolution

· Decision making

· Openness to criticism

· Good proficiency in written \& spoken communication skills.

**EXPERIENCE RANGE: (IN YRS) : 3 \+ Years**

**EDUCATION QUALIFICATION REQUIRED:**

B E / Diploma / MBA / Post Graduation with relevant experience of managing IT Infra Projects

**ADDITIONAL CERTIFICATIONS REQUIRED**

Optional: PMP Certification

**Any Interested candidates can share their CV on devarshim@microlink.co.in or Whatsapp 9016706079 .** 

Pay: ₹45,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
